cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: Sit down, Gillian. It's safer in a crowd.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: You really fooled me, playing two parts like that.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: Action!

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: Bless you.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: I wasn't trying to fool you. Being an informant is a dangerous business.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: You never reveal your identity.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Still, I feel cheated.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I asked you where Outer Heaven was, and you worked there all along.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: I was the one who was surprised.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: I didn't know Gibson had been to the club. I was off that day.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: It's not costume time tonight. Take off the mask, Napoleon.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Talking to a werewolf makes me nervous.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: Well, if you don't mind.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: Whew! This full-face mask gets pretty stuffy.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Maybe you should've left it on.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: What?

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: How did you figure it out?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That werewolf in the message.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: KTT would never use a picture that tasteless.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: And your sneeze clinched it.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: My sneeze, huh? Want to know why they call me Napoleon?

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: I can't handle winter.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: Napoleon Bonaparte sent his Grand Army into Russia in 1812.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: The snow forced him into a disastrous retreat.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I see.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: But my sneezing is caused by Snow Cedar pollen.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: So, what do you want?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I have a question.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: Go ahead.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's it! Benson!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Benson? Could it be Chief Benson Cunningham?
cues.note: 2026-11-07: the engine animates the other speaker (f10 Metal Gear, f11 Gillian); the Japanese of both is plain speech, no polite ending either way - kept as all three ports have it, to be settled by ear

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Or our mechanic. His full name is Harry Benson.
cues.note: 2026-11-07: the engine animates the other speaker (f10 Metal Gear, f11 Gillian); the Japanese of both is plain speech, no polite ending either way - kept as all three ports have it, to be settled by ear

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: One of those two is a Snatcher.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: They've even infiltrated JUNKER headquarters.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Now we know how they anticipated our every move.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We send all our investigation data to headquarters.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, stop sending data to headquarters. Now!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'm doing it now.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I've disconnected the automatic transfer routine.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: No more data will be sent.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: A Snatcher at JUNKER headquarters. Damn it!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We need proof of which one is a Snatcher, as soon as possible.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, hurry to JUNKER HQ!

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: See you, JUNKER. Today's information is on me.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: Take care, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: Don't let those Snatchers get you.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: I'll lie low for a while. You're my best source of income.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: You take care too, Napoleon. Dead men don't sneeze.

cues.speaker: Napoleon
cues.en: What are you talking about?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: See you, Napoleon.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Let's go, Metal.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Beryllium is Be.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Nitrogen is N.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Sulfur is S.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Oxygen is O.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: So it's Benson.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The name Benson was hidden in this record.
